# SKStacks

> SKStacks is the public SKWorld infrastructure framework. v1 is a set of
> Ansible playbooks that deploy pinned, self-hosted services to Docker Swarm,
> and it is what production clusters run on. v2 (in development) describes each
> service once in an app.yaml descriptor and renders it for Swarm, Kubernetes,
> RKE2 or k3d.

## Framework and instance model

The public framework (github.com/smilinTux/skstacks) carries the playbooks,
stacks and secret backends with no estate-specific values. A private instance
repo pins it as a `framework/` git submodule at a release tag
(`skstacks-vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`) and supplies the inventory, per-environment
values and encrypted secrets. Upgrading means bumping the submodule to a newer
tag. Every image is pinned to an explicit tag or digest (a test enforces it),
Renovate keeps the pins current, and every change runs template render tests
plus the skred security gate.

## Current catalog (generated by scripts/gen-data.py)

<!-- gen:catalog -->
Latest release: skstacks-v2.26.32 (2026-11-23)

v1 services (46), by category:

### Edge and security
- skfence (core): Single-node Traefik edge (reverse proxy/TLS)
- skfenceha (core): HA multi-manager Traefik edge
- skha (core): Keepalived VRRP floating VIP
- sksec (core): CrowdSec agent + Traefik bouncer
- skaegis (optional): Continuous CVE detection: the Detect step of the suite (Defend sksec, Detect skaegis, Remediate skpatch)
- skbom (optional): OWASP Dependency-Track (SBOM store + CVE matching), the image-patching half of the skpatch program
- skpatch-hosts (optional): Linux update/patch dashboard (SSH, holds a key per estate); host half of the skpatch program
- sksec-web (optional): CrowdSec Web UI

### Identity and access
- skdesk (optional): RustDesk relay (hbbs/hbbr)
- skmesh (optional): Netbird self-hosted WireGuard mesh VPN
- skrac (optional): MeshCentral on the swarm: remote access and device management
- sksso (optional): Authentik OIDC identity provider

### Observability and operations
- skdash (optional): Dashy service dashboard, Traefik-API discovery
- skhealth (optional): Lightweight infrastructure health checks with alerts
- skmon (optional): Observability stack (metrics, logs, alerts, optional profiles)
- sknet (optional): Network flow visibility: Akvorado flow collector and console (Kafka + ClickHouse), optional live view
- skport (optional): Portainer CE (Swarm web UI)
- skpulse (optional): Uptime Kuma status monitoring
- skwhoami (optional): traefik/whoami echo/test service

### Data and storage
- skbackup (optional): Snapshots, per-app copies, dump hooks, restic offsite, restore tests, alerts on the storage host
- skgraph (optional): FalkorDB graph database (Redis protocol)
- skmem-pg (optional): Postgres 17 + pgvector + pg_search + AGE
- skreg (optional): Docker Registry v2
- skstor (optional): Garage S3-compatible object storage
- sksync (optional): Syncthing continuous file sync
- skvector (optional): Qdrant vector database

### Collaboration and productivity
- skboard (optional): Vikunja task board (sqlite)
- skbook (optional): BookStack wiki + MariaDB
- skhub (optional): Nextcloud file sync/collaboration
- skmail (optional): Full SMTP/IMAP mail server
- skpages (optional): Agent-published HTML pages
- skpdf (optional): Stirling-PDF toolkit
- skpods (optional): Solid pod hosting (WebID + storage per user); engine nextcloud: a slim standalone Nextcloud with only the Solid app

### Automation and development
- skflow (optional): Windmill workflow engine shared by tenant stacks (flows, schedules, webhooks, approvals)
- skform (optional): OpenTofu CLI container (idle, docker exec-driven)
- skgit (optional): Forgejo git + CI runners
- skorch (optional): n8n workflow automation
- skpayment (optional): Multi-app Stripe subscription gateway (FastAPI on uvicorn)
- skwrit (optional): Matter engine worker (drafting with gates, release, publishing to Nextcloud)

### Search and AI
- skpeek (optional): SearXNG metasearch engine
- skseek (optional): Perplexica AI search UI

### Media and home
- skfetch (optional): Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr and qBittorrent behind a VPN
- skgallery (optional): Immich photo/video management
- skgym (optional): openGym gym and body-weight tracker (passkeys, PWA)
- skhome (optional): HomeCenter home/property/vehicle/health manager
- skstream (optional): Plex + Real-Debrid (DUMB)

v2 descriptors (28, in development): capauth, skca, sksec, sksso, skvault, skwaf, skbus, skchat, skcomms, skvoice, skbackup, skblock, skcache, skdata, skfile, skfiles, skflow, skmodel, skmon, skobject, skpulse, skcicd, skdns, skdweb, skfence, skinfra, skmesh, skturn
